source_title: Naruto Creator Kishimoto Officially Gives Naruto New Kekkei Genkai
source_excerpt:
Masashi Kishimoto established Naruto Uzumaki as a protagonist with little talent at his disposal. Naruto's biggest strength ended up becoming the power of Kurama, which was his biggest weakness and harmed him on multiple occasions. However, through sheer perseverance and hard work, Naruto Uzumaki reached the very top by the end of the original series on November 10, 2014.
Now, after 12 long years, the Naruto series is coming back, with Masashi Kishimoto officially confirmed to be writing a new Naruto manga titled “Naruto: Shadow Rising.” This new manga is once again bringing back Naruto's three new Kekkei Genkai and powering him up to a whole new level, with the return of the Six Paths Sage Mode as well.
New Naruto Manga By Kishimoto Is Returning Lava Release, Boil Release, And Magnet Release To Naruto Uzumaki
The Naruto series has already received a continuation in the form of Boruto and Boruto: Two Blue Vortex . The Boruto series is set in a time period where Naruto reigns supreme as the Seventh Hokage, and the Earth faces many threats, including the likes of the Otsutsuki. In this new series, Naruto Uzumaki has been given the opportunity to show his immense strength on multiple occasions, including in his battle against Momoshiki, Jigen, and Isshiki Otsutsuki. In Boruto: Naruto Next Generations Chapter 52, released officially on November 20, 2020, in V-Jump Issue 1, Naruto Uzumaki tapped into a new power called Baryon Mode. This new power saw Naruto and Kurama's chakra being taken and used as raw materials to create a completely new form of energy . This energy was so great that it eclipsed Isshiki Otsutsuki's power entirely, but the price to pay for utilizing it was also huge.
"This is a completely different beast. The other modes involve taking chakra that you acquire from elsewhere and just using it. Here, yours and my chakra are used as raw materials to create a different form of energy, until both of our lives run out." — Kurama explains Baryon Mode, Boruto Chapter #52
While Naruto successfully led to the defeat of Ishiki, he also ended up losing the power of Kurama permanently. At the same time, Naruto also lost his Six Paths Sage Mode forever, and this took away his three Kekkei Genkai forever . Naruto Uzumaki was then subsequently sealed away in Boruto Chapter 77 on January 19, 2023.
"The Seventh died at Boruto's hands. That's what you'll tell them! Got it?" — Kawaki spreads the news of Naruto's death, Boruto Chapter #79
Now, three years later, Masashi Kishimoto is bringing back Naruto Uzumaki once again in a brand new manga, which is a sequel to the original Naruto series. This new manga will not only give back to Naruto Uzumaki his Six Paths Sage Mode, but three Kekkei Genkai as well, those being Boil Release, Lava Release, and Magnet Release. These Kekkei Genkai were not used by Naruto Uzumaki to their fullest extent in the Fourth Great Ninja War and were taken away too early in the Boruto series.
Naruto: Shadow Rising will give Kishimoto the perfect opportunity to show their true powers, and we are all excited for that. Naruto's Lava Release comes directly from the Four-Tails, Son Goku. This power was used by Naruto Uzumaki briefly in the Fourth Great Ninja War, especially when he cut down the God Tree before Madara eventually went on to absorb it.
Naruto: Understood! Senpou: Yoton Rasenshuriken!
— Naruto uses Lava Release, Naruto Chapter #673
Naruto also utilized Boil Release in the battle against Kaguya Otsutsuki, and its powers were great enough to give him a temporary boost, which saw him rip one of her arms off. Naruto also utilized Magnet Release on various occasions, such as when he saved Might Guy's life, and later, when he sealed Madara's Limbo Shadows effortlessly. These legendary Kekkei Genkai power up Naruto to a completely new level and make him a force to be reckoned with.
Why Naruto Could Use Wood Release As His 4th Kekkei Genkai in New Manga
Naruto Uzumaki already has access to three different Kekkei Genkai, and these new powers will be given to him in the Shadow Rising manga as Kishimoto returns. There is also a fourth Kekkei Genkai that Naruto Uzumaki could gain in the new Shadow Rising manga. In Naruto chapter 699, which was also released on November 10, 2014, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 50, Naruto Uzumaki received a prosthetic arm made with Hashirama's cells. These Hashirama cells carry the Kekkei Genkai of Wood Release. To be able to utilize Wood Release, Naruto would simply need to learn Earth and Water Release and combine these two powers.
"Are you sure you don't want to stay, Sasuke? Tsunade-sama just completed making the prosthetic arms for you and Naruto using Hashirama cells." — Sakura explains Naruto's Hashirama cell upgrade, Naruto Chapter #699
Given that Naruto Uzumaki has access to all five Nature Transformations after the Fourth Great Ninja War, he can combine these two to create Wood Release when he has access to Hashirama's cells. Unfortunately, in the Boruto series, Naruto has never made use of Wood Release, but now, in the new Naruto Shadow Rising manga, he could gain access to his fourth Kekkei Genkai in the form of Wood Release and replicate some of the incredible feats of the First Hokage, Hashirama Senju.
If Naruto Uzumaki were to be given this legendary power, fans all over the world would absolutely love it because not only would it improve his battle arsenal, but it would also go on to show his exceptional mastery over ninjutsu and solidify his status as a god of ninja.

Naruto: Shadow Rising is going to be incredible for the protagonist Naruto Uzumaki and also Sasuke Uchiha. This new manga is being written by Kishimoto himself, so fans can rest assured that Naruto's power will be scaled properly, unlike in the Boruto series. Naruto's Six Paths Sage Mode will be taken to a brand-new level in the new Shadow Rising manga, but at the same time, he could also be given new abilities such as Wood Release.
Furthermore, Naruto Uzumaki was seen fighting in the Fourth Great Ninja War with only half of Kurama. After the war, Naruto received the second half of Kurama, but the full powers of this beast with Naruto were never truly shown to us. Naruto: Shadow Rising will show a new level of Naruto Uzumaki, where he has both halves of Kurama sealed inside him, with Hashirama cells to boost his chakra recovery rate and grant him a brand-new Kekkei Genkai, alongside the Six Paths Sage Mode, which grants him access to half of Hagoromo Otsutsuki's powers as well as three distinct Kekkei Genkai.
All these abilities will be utilized by Naruto Uzumaki to a completely new level, which might result in us seeing the strongest version of Naruto in the entire history of the franchise. Needless to say, we cannot wait to see what Masashi Kishimoto does with the Naruto: Shadow Rising manga. As things stand, no release date for this manga has been revealed yet, but an update is already scheduled to be delivered on December 19 and December 20, 2026, at the Naruto stage at Jump Festa 2027 , held in Tokyo.
All chapters of the Boruto: Two Blue Vortex manga by Mikio Ikemoto, supervised by Masashi Kishimoto, are available to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
